headline: Tuckin Build
title: Tuckin Build | Draw Nourishment and Breaking Roar | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Tuckin is a Grass tank and Break Aniimo. Its trait, Prank Master, raises Break damage for every thousand max health, and it summons Hummin helpers in battle. So put points into health and Break first. Guides pick Draw Nourishment for sustain and Off-Key Shock Wave as a cheap Break skill, with Breaking Roar as the ultimate. Held item picks vary, so test them. Do you run Tuckin? Comment below!
description: Tuckin build in Aniimo: HP and Break stat priority, Draw Nourishment and Off-Key Shock Wave, with Breaking Roar as the ultimate. Prank Master scales Break damage with max HP.
joke: Tuckin brings the helpers, and I bring the snacks.
